user_stories.title: Create Source with Auto-Metadata Extraction
user_stories.description: As a researcher, I want to add a source to my vault by providing a URL so that metadata (title, authors, abstract) is automatically extracted
acceptance_criteria: If title not provided, auto-extract from URL using newspaper3k/beautifulsoup
Extract metadata: authors, publication_date, abstract (best effort)
Vault permission check: user must be Owner or Contributor

tasks.title: Define Source model with SourceType enum
tasks.description: Create Source model in apps/sources/models.py with fields: vault FK, url, title, description, source_type (enum: URL/PDF/BOOK/JOURNAL/DATASET), metadata JSON, created_by FK, is_deleted, timestamps. Add indexes and unique constraint.

tasks.title: Implement extract_metadata() service
tasks.description: Create apps/sources/services.py with extract_metadata(url) function using newspaper3k or beautifulsoup4. Extract title, authors, publication_date, abstract. Handle timeouts (10s max), HTTP errors, parse failures with graceful fallbacks.

tasks.title: Create SourceSerializer with auto-metadata
tasks.description: Implement SourceSerializer in apps/sources/serializers.py. Override create() to call extract_metadata() if title not provided. Validate metadata JSON schema.

tasks.title: Implement SourceViewSet with create endpoint
tasks.description: Create SourceViewSet in apps/sources/views.py with create action. Add VaultPermission check (Owner/Contributor). Integrate SourceSerializer. Return 201 on success.

tasks.title: Write tests for source creation and metadata extraction
tasks.description: Create test_models.py, test_views.py, test_services.py. Test source creation, metadata extraction with mocked HTTP responses, permission checks, validation errors.

user_stories.title: Bulk Source Import
user_stories.description: As a researcher, I want to import multiple sources at once via URL array so that I can quickly populate my vault from a reference list
acceptance_criteria: Validates all URLs before processing (duplicate check within vault)
Checks URL reachability (HTTP HEAD request, 5s timeout)
Single audit log entry: source.bulk_imported with count

tasks.title: Create BulkSourceSerializer
tasks.description: Implement BulkSourceSerializer in apps/sources/serializers.py. Accept {"urls": []} field. Validate max 50 URLs, URL format, duplicates within vault using database query.

tasks.title: Implement bulk_import custom action
tasks.description: Add @action(methods=['post']) bulk_import() to SourceViewSet. Check URL reachability with HTTP HEAD (5s timeout). Call extract_metadata() for each URL. Use Django transaction for atomicity. Return created/skipped/errors breakdown.

tasks.title: Write bulk import tests
tasks.description: Test bulk import with valid URLs, duplicates, unreachable URLs, max batch size validation, permission checks. Mock HTTP requests.

user_stories.title: List & Filter Sources
user_stories.description: As a researcher, I want to filter sources by vault, type, date range, creator, tags, and search text so that I can quickly find relevant sources
acceptance_criteria: tags filter searches metadata.tags array (PostgreSQL JSON query)
Vault permission: any vault member can list sources

tasks.title: Create SourceFilter with django-filter
tasks.description: Implement SourceFilter in apps/sources/filters.py. Add filters: vault, source_type, created_by, tags (custom method using JSON overlap), date_from/date_to (created_at range), search (title/description icontains).

tasks.title: Add filterset_class to SourceViewSet
tasks.description: Integrate SourceFilter into SourceViewSet. Configure pagination (20 per page). Add default filter: is_deleted=False. Ensure vault permission check.

tasks.title: Write filter tests
tasks.description: Test all filter combinations: vault, source_type, created_by, tags (JSON query), date range, search. Test pagination. Verify soft-deleted sources excluded.

user_stories.title: Update Source
user_stories.description: As a researcher, I want to edit source title, description, metadata, and type so that I can correct or enrich source information
acceptance_criteria: Audit log: source.updated with JSON diff of changes

tasks.title: Configure SourceSerializer for partial updates
tasks.description: Set read_only_fields for url, vault, created_by in SourceSerializer. Ensure partial=True works for PATCH requests.

tasks.title: Add update endpoint to SourceViewSet
tasks.description: Implement update/partial_update in SourceViewSet. Verify VaultPermission (Owner/Contributor). Return 200 with updated object.

tasks.title: Write update tests
tasks.description: Test PATCH with valid data, immutable field attempts, permission checks (non-member, Viewer role). Verify audit log creation.

user_stories.title: Soft Delete Source
user_stories.description: As a researcher, I want to delete a source without permanently removing it so that I can restore it later if needed
acceptance_criteria: Deleted sources excluded from list views by default

tasks.title: Override destroy() for soft delete
tasks.description: Override destroy() method in SourceViewSet to set is_deleted=True instead of hard delete. Check VaultPermission (Owner only). Return 204.

tasks.title: Write soft delete tests
tasks.description: Test DELETE sets is_deleted=True, source excluded from list, Owner-only permission, audit log creation.

user_stories.title: Restore Deleted Source
user_stories.description: As a vault owner, I want to restore a soft-deleted source so that I can recover accidentally deleted sources

tasks.title: Implement restore custom action
tasks.description: Add @action(methods=['post'], detail=True) restore() to SourceViewSet. Set is_deleted=False. Check VaultPermission (Owner). Return 200 with source.

tasks.title: Write restore tests
tasks.description: Test restore sets is_deleted=False, source reappears in list, Owner-only permission, audit log creation.

user_stories.title: Create Top-Level Annotation
user_stories.description: As a researcher, I want to add an annotation to a source with flexible positioning so that I can highlight and comment on specific parts
acceptance_criteria: Optional: page_number, parent (must be null for top-level)
Vault permission: any vault member can annotate

tasks.title: Define Annotation model with threading
tasks.description: Create Annotation model in apps/annotations/models.py with fields: source FK, user FK, content, page_number, position JSON, parent self-FK, timestamps. Add clean() method to validate 2-level max threading. Add indexes.

tasks.title: Create AnnotationSerializer with position validation
tasks.description: Implement AnnotationSerializer in apps/annotations/serializers.py. Validate position JSON has at least one of: page, x, y, selector. Include user as read-only StringRelatedField.

tasks.title: Implement AnnotationViewSet with create endpoint
tasks.description: Create AnnotationViewSet in apps/annotations/views.py. Add create action with vault member permission check. Auto-set user from request. Return 201.

tasks.title: Write annotation creation tests
tasks.description: Test top-level annotation creation, position validation, permission checks, audit log creation. Test various position schemas (PDF, web selector).

user_stories.title: Reply to Annotation (One Level Deep)
user_stories.description: As a researcher, I want to reply to an existing annotation so that I can engage in threaded discussions
acceptance_criteria: Validates: parent must not have a parent (2-level max)
Required: content, source (inherited from parent), parent
position optional for replies (defaults to parent's position)

tasks.title: Add threading validation to AnnotationSerializer
tasks.description: Add validate() method to AnnotationSerializer to check if parent.parent exists. Raise ValidationError if attempting to reply to a reply.

tasks.title: Write annotation reply tests
tasks.description: Test creating reply to top-level annotation, attempt to reply to reply (should fail), verify parent set correctly, audit log creation.

user_stories.title: List Annotations for Source
user_stories.description: As a researcher, I want to view all annotations for a source grouped by thread so that I can see discussions in context

tasks.title: Add nested replies to AnnotationSerializer
tasks.description: Add get_replies() SerializerMethodField to AnnotationSerializer. Use prefetch_related('replies') for performance. Only include replies for top-level annotations (parent=None).

tasks.title: Implement list endpoint with filtering
tasks.description: Override list() in AnnotationViewSet to filter by source, order by created_at. Add filterset for user, page_number. Configure pagination (50 per page). Use prefetch_related.

tasks.title: Write annotation list tests
tasks.description: Test nested structure returned, filters work (user, page_number), pagination, ordering, permission checks. Verify prefetch_related reduces queries.

user_stories.title: Update Annotation
user_stories.description: As a researcher, I want to edit my own annotation content so that I can correct or clarify my notes
acceptance_criteria: Permission: only annotation author can edit

tasks.title: Create IsAuthorOrReadOnly permission
tasks.description: Implement IsAuthorOrReadOnly permission class in apps/annotations/permissions.py. Allow safe methods for all, write methods only for author.

tasks.title: Configure AnnotationSerializer for updates
tasks.description: Set read_only_fields: position, page_number, parent, source, user in AnnotationSerializer. Only content is mutable.

tasks.title: Add IsAuthorOrReadOnly to AnnotationViewSet
tasks.description: Add IsAuthorOrReadOnly to permission_classes in AnnotationViewSet. Implement update/partial_update.

tasks.title: Write annotation update tests
tasks.description: Test PATCH as author succeeds, non-author fails (403), immutable field attempts rejected, audit log with diff created.

user_stories.title: Delete Annotation
user_stories.description: As a researcher, I want to delete my own annotation so that I can remove outdated or incorrect notes
acceptance_criteria: Permission: only annotation author can delete
If annotation has replies, cascade delete all replies (warning in response)

tasks.title: Implement delete with cascade warning
tasks.description: Override destroy() in AnnotationViewSet. Check if replies exist, include warning in response headers. Hard delete (cascade via FK on_delete). Check IsAuthorOrReadOnly permission. Return 204.

tasks.title: Write annotation delete tests
tasks.description: Test DELETE as author succeeds, non-author fails, cascade delete of replies verified, audit log created.

user_stories.title: Log All Source & Annotation Changes
user_stories.description: As a system administrator, I want to track all changes to sources and annotations so that research integrity is maintained
acceptance_criteria: Every create/update/delete action creates an AuditLog entry
Fields: action, user, timestamp, object_type, object_id, changes (JSON diff)
Queryable via admin interface or API endpoint

tasks.title: Extend AuditLog model with changes field
tasks.description: Add changes JSONField to AuditLog model in core/models.py (or create if not exists). Add Meta to prevent updates. Register in admin.

tasks.title: Create source signals for audit logging
tasks.description: Implement post_save, pre_delete signals in apps/sources/signals.py. Use django-dirtyfields to capture before/after. Create AuditLog entries for source.created, source.updated, source.deleted, source.restored.

tasks.title: Create annotation signals for audit logging
tasks.description: Implement post_save, pre_delete signals in apps/annotations/signals.py. Create AuditLog entries for annotation.created, annotation.replied, annotation.updated, annotation.deleted with changes diff.

tasks.title: Write audit log tests
tasks.description: Test all CRUD operations trigger correct audit log entries with proper action names, user, changes JSON. Verify immutability of logs.

user_stories.title: URL Routing & App Registration
user_stories.description: Register apps and configure URL routing for all source and annotation endpoints
acceptance_criteria: All endpoints accessible via API router

tasks.title: Register apps in settings
tasks.description: Add 'apps.sources' and 'apps.annotations' to INSTALLED_APPS in config/settings.py.

tasks.title: Configure URL routing
tasks.description: Create apps/sources/urls.py and apps/annotations/urls.py with DRF router. Include in config/urls.py under /api/v1/. Configure nested routing for /vaults/{id}/sources/.

tasks.title: Update CORS settings
tasks.description: Ensure CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS includes frontend URL in config/settings.py.

user_stories.title: Database Migrations & Admin Setup
user_stories.description: Generate migrations for all models and configure Django admin interface
acceptance_criteria: Models registered in admin with list_display, filters

tasks.title: Generate and apply migrations
tasks.description: Run makemigrations and migrate for apps.sources, apps.annotations, core (AuditLog). Verify indexes created in PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Configure Django admin
tasks.description: Register Source, Annotation, AuditLog in admin.py files. Add list_display, list_filter, search_fields. Make AuditLog read-only.

user_stories.title: Full Integration Testing
user_stories.description: Run complete test suite and perform manual API testing
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests for full CRUD flows pass
No regressions in existing vault/user tests

tasks.title: Run full test suite
tasks.description: Execute: python manage.py test apps.sources apps.annotations. Ensure all tests pass. Verify test coverage >80%.

tasks.title: Manual API testing
tasks.description: Follow scenarios in .planning/MANUAL_VERIFICATION.md. Test all endpoints with Postman/Thunder Client. Verify responses, permissions, audit logs.

tasks.title: Update MANUAL_VERIFICATION.md
tasks.description: Append all test scenarios from Appendix A of PRD to .planning/MANUAL_VERIFICATION.md with checkboxes.
